context:
Goal: idle lanes archive fast without losing unmerged work.
Problem (rule): the guard that stops a lane's branch being dropped unsaved accepts it as saved only when an archive copy under the lane's own branch names exists; a copy under another archive name with the exact same last commit is refused, a false alarm the coordinator hit.
Based on (read): hooks/own_session.py lines 105-130 and hooks/guard_merge.py line 1636; the own-names limit came from the Nov 9 scope reading, to bound the comparisons the guard runs.
Based on (ruling): the Oct 30 grant lets a branch go when its last commit is on any archive branch (step cloud-branch-delete); it covers deleting a branch, not this guard.
Departs from: main accepts only the lane's own archive names — a accepts any archive copy whose last commit is the exact same.

options.gain: No false refusal; an exact match needs no comparisons, so the Nov 9 bound still holds.
options.how: The guard lists every archive branch once and accepts the lane's branch as saved when any of them ends on exactly the same commit. Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.
options.label: Accept any copy with the same commit
options.lose: The guard accepts more than today, and reads the list of all archive branches once per check.

options.how: Keep accepting only an archive copy under the lane's own branch names; a session that archived under another name pushes one more copy under the lane's own name.
options.label: Own names only (Recommended)
options.lose: The false refusal stays until a session re-archives under the lane's own name.

ref: coordinator 12:44 CST Nov 12, from lane archive-flow
reply: Settled by your Oct 27 ruling (decision uniform-over-variants: a shared tool never grows a second accepted form): b. The archive guard keeps accepting only the lane's own archive names; a session that archived under another name pushes one more copy under the lane's own name. No answer needed from you.
short: Archive guard: any copy with same commit?
title: Should the archive guard accept any archive copy with the same last commit?
why: It changes what a safety guard accepts, so it needs your word; the lane builds only the wording change meanwhile.
